items.summary: Kite Realty Group Trust sits in a price target range that clusters around US$29 to US$33, with updated fair value work now pointing to US$30.50. Analysts linking this range to refreshed models see the new fair value as consistent with recent optimism on operations and funds from operations, while also acknowledging more measured expectations after a period of outperformance. items.title: Bank Stocks Drop From Record Highs Ahead of Fed Meeting
